title: UPSSSC Inter (12th) Level Recruitment 2026
summary: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) , has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Inter (12th) Level Posts. This recruitment is for 1784 posts . UPSSSC Application Form has started on 10 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 01 December 2026 . The Minimum age required is 18 – 21 Years Post Wise & The Maximum Age Is 30 – 40 Years as on 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSSSC Inter (12th) Level Recruitment 2026 which has given below. ( Advt. No. 26-Exam/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have UPSSSC PET 2025 Qualified + Intermediate (12th) or equivalent & CCC Degree from a recognized board + 3-Year Agriculture Experience from UP Board of Technical Education or an equivalent AICTE-approved qualification. For Post Wise Qualification Details Read Official Notification.
